title: Esteban Maroto
description: "l would love to draw (the STAR WARS characters) in their remote worlds far away from the limits of our galaxy," reflects Esteban Maroto, "in the deep corners of my fantasy away from this reality that saddens me in its monotony'." A successful fantasy illustrator in Spain, Maroto first came to the attention of U.S. fans with splendid work for Warren's CREEPY, EERIE, VAMPIRELLA and DRACULA books. Equally interesting was his DC period (AMETHYST, ZATANNA THE MAGICIAN, ATIANTIS CHRONICLES) and recent work for Topps (VLAD THE IMPALER).
